# Contributing to PFMM

The contribution guide lives in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) at the repository
root — repository layout, the devcontainer workflow, tests, building the air-gapped
bundle, and how to open a pull request.

This file exists only because GitHub also looks for a contribution guide under `.github/`.
Keeping the content in one place avoids two guides drifting apart; please edit the root
one.

For API documentation and how to regenerate it from the `.proto` files, see
[`api/README.md`](../api/README.md).
